newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India sells 50,000/T of September naphtha to Vitol.
newsitem.headline: India sells 50,000/T of September naphtha to Vitol.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has sold through a tender two cargoes of naphtha lifting in September to Dutch trader Vitol, traders said on Thursday.

Traders said Vitol won the first cargo of 25,000 tonnes of high aromatic naphtha lifting from Bombay on the west coast between September 11-12 at $23.34 per tonne discount to northwest European spot prices on a free-on-board (fob) basis.

The second cargo of 25,000 tonnes of low aromatic naphtha lifting from Vizag on the east coast between September 8-10, was also awared to Vitol at $32.39 per tonne below Mediterranean spot quotes on a fob basis.
